(iii) What does "a bower quiet" provide?  (a) A peaceful shelter for the mind  (b) A noisy party  (c) A crowded market  (d) A long journey
(iv) What is the central idea of these lines?
items.answer: (i) "A Thing of Beauty" by John Keats (from "Endymion"). (ii) (d) It increases (iii) (a) A peaceful shelter for the mind (iv) Beauty gives lasting joy and peace.
